thread:
alex: Morning team — quick ask about tomorrow's RFC review lineup. I need to swap authors for the 11:30 slot. Can someone cover queuing?

maria: @alex I can take the 11:30 slot if you move authors, what's expected prep?

alex: Ideally just a 10-min pre-read check: confirm authors uploaded pre-read, reviewers have comments in GH. Main ask: reorder agenda so 'model admission rollup' goes first.

sam: I'm OOO until 10:00 PT but can join by 11:15 for handoff.

nate: I have review notes, would prefer the model admission later — we've got infra blockers. If we push it later we can show perf graphs.

linda: +1 to moving perf demo later. Also can we ping authors to update the 'known-issues' section in the doc?

alex: OK, proposed plan: move 'model admission rollup' to first, then perf demo, then infra followups. @dev-bot can you post a pre-read reminder to #eng at 09:00?

dev-bot: scheduled reminder posted to #eng for 09:00 — "RFC review pre-read: please upload notes and tag reviewers" :bell: 

maria: I'll DM authors and ask for PR links + a short summary in the pre-read doc.

sam: Can we do a 5-min dry run after lunch? Quick checklist: 1) slides in drive 2) GH comments linked 3) owner for Q&A

alex: Perfect. I'll update the calendar agenda and the lanes. Quick helper to fetch pre-reads locally: 
```
./tools/fetch_prereads --meeting rfc-review --since 48h
```

nate: ack. If anyone can't make it, ping in this thread and we can reshuffle.

linda: I'll take ownership of the perf demo handover, will upload notes and a short runbook. :thumbsup:

alex: Thanks — I'll send an updated calendar invite now and post the final lane order here once done.
